# Changelog - nuget-release

Following [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/).

## [Unreleased]

### Added
- Project-owned SemVer, changelog/tag/package validation, draft-first release
  template, trusted publishing, fake-transport decision tests, and explicit recovery.
- Peer-review corrections for separate symbol publication, strict schema types,
  and wrapper-level duplicate, stale-tag, backport, and partial-failure cases.
